“BHA 20923 INDIA INSURANCE REGULATORY AND AND agua Saar ieglai DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF AUTHORITY OF OF INDIA - b) The existing Appointed Actuaries, appointed with the support of a mentor actuary for a limited period, may continue to work as Appointed Actuary beyond this period without mentor provided the Appointed Actuary complies with all the provisions of the captioned Regulations to work as Appointed Actuary on standalone basis. The insurer shall inform the Authority within 30 days before expiry of such limited period along with fresh Form IRDAI-AA-2. - c) The existing Appointed Actuaries not falling under (a) and (b) above may continue as per the provisions of Regulation 3(C) of the captioned Regulations. This circular comes into force with immediate effect. This is issued with approval of the Competent Authority. SHYAMA Digitally signed by PRASAD SHYAMA PRASAD CHAKRABORTY CHAKRABORTY **S.P.
